definitions.explanation: To cease to be visible or to exist; to vanish from sight.

definitions.gloss: to go out, to be extinguished
definitions.explanation: For a light, fire, or similar to stop burning or shining.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{人混|ひとご}みの{中|なか}に{消|き}えた。
{電気|でんき}が{消|き}えている。
examples.notes: {消|き}えている describes the resulting state

examples.japanese: {雪|ゆき}がだんだん{消|き}えていく。
examples.english: The snow is gradually melting away.

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}が{急|きゅう}に{消|き}えた。
{時間|じかん}がたつと、{悲|かな}しい{気持|きも}ちも{少|すこ}しずつ{消|き}えていく。
examples.english: As time passes, sad feelings gradually fade away.

examples.japanese: {風|かぜ}で{ろうそく|ろうそく}の{火|ひ}が{消|き}えた。
examples.english: The candle went out in the wind.

examples.japanese: {停電|ていでん}で{部屋|へや}の{明|あ}かりが{消|き}えた。
examples.english: The lights in the room went out due to a power outage.

examples.japanese: ガスの{火|ひ}が{消|き}えていないか{確認|かくにん}してください。
examples.english: Please check whether the gas flame has gone out.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}になったら{星|ほし}の{光|ひかり}が{消|き}えた。
examples.english: When morning came, the starlight faded.

examples.japanese: {夜|よる}{遅|おそ}くまで{起|お}きていたら、{隣|となり}の{家|いえ}の{電気|でんき}が{一|ひと}つずつ{消|き}えていった。
examples.english: When I stayed up late at night, the lights in the neighboring houses went out one by one.

notes:
{消|き}える is an intransitive verb meaning to disappear or go out.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし})
- Pair: {消|け}す (transitive - to turn off, to erase)
- Pattern: Xが{消|き}える

ASPECT (ている):
- {消|き}えている = is off, has disappeared (resulting state)
- Example: {電気|でんき}が{消|き}えている (the light is off)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電気|でんき}が{消|き}える (light goes out)
- {火|ひ}が{消|き}える (fire goes out)
- {姿|すがた}が{消|き}える (figure disappears)
- {記憶|きおく}が{消|き}える (memory fades)
